completion_target.name: CW Plugin / App Candidate
completion_target.description: Prove that the accepted CW engine and MCP surface are packaged as an installable, reviewable local OpenAI plugin candidate without public submission or additional capabilities.

requirements.description: Use the current official OpenAI plugin package model and supported manifest fields.
evidence_expectations: Validated plugin manifest, skill layout, bundled MCP configuration, and official-document decision record.

requirements.description: Provide a valid production CW skill that preserves evidence-first workflow semantics.
evidence_expectations: Skill validator and deterministic behavioral contract tests.

requirements.description: Expose exactly the accepted CW 0.9 MCP tool surface.
Map READ, EXECUTION, and CONTROLLED_STATE_MUTATION accurately while excluding HIGH_CONSEQUENCE_AUTHORIZATION.
evidence_expectations: Capability map, tool annotations, server-side mismatch test, and forbidden-tool audit.

requirements.description: Preserve project scope, actor/origin, injection resistance, idempotency, redaction, and minimum disclosure.
evidence_expectations: Plugin threat model and deterministic malicious-client tests.

requirements.description: Validate local Codex discovery/installation and the governed MCP connection on a disposable initialized project.
evidence_expectations: Official local plugin tooling plus deterministic MCP lifecycle evidence.

requirements.description: Classify ChatGPT desktop-local and web/public support from current official documentation without false compatibility claims.
evidence_expectations: Documented surface matrix and remote/authentication boundary.

requirements.description: Document ordinary CLI, MCP extra, plugin discovery, initialized-project onboarding, and limitations.
evidence_expectations: Strict documentation build and link/policy checks.

requirements.description: Keep ordinary CLI/MCP packaging intact and validate plugin package integrity cross-platform.
evidence_expectations: Full suite, plugin validator, wheel acceptance, and native platform CI contract.
